description: Couple mates so one drives the other: GEAR (two revolutes, ratio), RACK_AND_PINION (a revolute and a slider, distance per revolution), SCREW (one cylindrical mate, distance per revolution) or LINEAR (two sliders, ratio). Each mate's degree of freedom follows from its type; cylindrical mates contribute whichever the relation needs. Mates missing the parameter relations need (made by hand-written payloads) are completed first and listed in completedMates. Fails if the relation does not regenerate.

distance_per_revolution.description: RACK_AND_PINION and SCREW: travel per full turn, inches. A pinion's is its pitch circumference.

dofs.description: Override the degree of freedom per mate: Rz rotation about, Tz translation along, its Z axis.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

mates.description: Mate feature ids: two, or one for SCREW.

ratio.description: GEAR and LINEAR: the ratio between the mates (default 1).

reverse.description: Reverse the direction of the coupling.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_assembly_relation
title: Relate two mates
